40007127.author: पदार्थः
40007127.content: सः खरः Khara, पुनः again, पतिताम्  fallen down, शूर्पणखाम् Surpanakha, दृष्ट्वा saw, अनर्थार्थम् unfortunate situation, आगताम्  who came, ताम् her, व्यक्तया in a clear, वाचा words, क्रोधात् angrily, उवाच spoke.

40007127.author: Translation
40007127.content: Seeing Surpanakha collapse, Khara said in clear terms about the unfortunate situation she had created:

40007128.author: पदार्थः
40007128.content: मया myself, त्वत्प्रियार्थम् for your pleasure, इदानीम् just now, रुधिराशनाः  who feed on blood, शूराः heroes, ते राक्षसाः those demons, विनिर्दिष्टाः commissioned, पुनः again, किमर्थम् for what reason, रुद्यते  crying.

40007128.author: Translation
40007128.content: The valiant demons who feed on blood have been commissioned for your pleasure. Why are you crying again?

40007129.author: पदार्थः
40007129.content: भक्ताश्चैव  devoted, अनुरक्ताश्च  fond of me, नित्यशः always, मम to me, हिताश्च wellwishers, हन्यमानाः while they are being attacked, न हन्यन्ते are not killed , मम my, वचः words, न न कुर्युः never fail to carry out my orders.

40007129.author: Translation
40007129.content: They are loyal and faithful to me. They are always my wellwishers. Even when attacked, they cannot be killed. They never fail to carry out my orders.

40007130.author: पदार्थः
40007130.content: यत्कृते for what reason, हा नाथ Ha Lord, इति saying like that, विनर्दन्ती lamenting, पुनः again, सर्पवत् like a serpent, क्षितौ on the ground, लुठसि you are rolling, एतत् this, कारणम् reason, किम् why, श्रोतुम् to hear, इच्छामि I wish.

40007130.author: Translation
40007130.content: I wish to know what makes you lament and roll on the ground like a serpent and hissing?

40007131.author: पदार्थः
40007131.content: नाथे as lord, मयि me, संस्थिते is present, अनाथवत् like an orphan, विलपसि you are weeping, उत्तिष्ठ you get up, मा भैषीः do not fear, इह now, वैक्लब्यम् worry, त्यज्यताम् may be given up.

40007131.author: Translation
40007131.content: When I am here like a lord to protect you, why do you weep like an orphan? Get up. Give up your anxiety. Be not afraid.

40007132.author: पदार्थः
40007132.content: इत्येवम् thus, उक्ता addressed, खरेण by Khara, परिसान्त्विता pacified, दुर्दर्षा in invincible woman, सास्रे tearful, नयने eyes, विमृज्य wiping, भ्रातरम् to brother, खरम् to Khara, अब्रवीत् said.

40007132.author: Translation
40007132.content: Thus consoled by Khara, invincible Surpanakha wiped her tearful eyes and said to her brother:

40007133.author: पदार्थः
40007133.content: हृतश्रवणनासिका with ears and nose sliced off, अहम् I, शोणितौघपरिक्लिन्ना drenched with flow of blood, इदानीम् now, प्राप्ता अस्मि myself having come, त्वया by you, परिसान्त्विता pacified, च also.

40007133.author: Translation
40007133.content: My ears and nose sliced off, drenched with blood, I came to you and you pacified me.

40007134.author: पदार्थः
40007134.content: वीर O hero, त्वया by you, क्रोधात् out of anger, मत्प्रियार्थम् to please me, सलक्ष्मणम् along with Lakshmana, राघवम् Rama, निहन्तुम् to kill, ते those, चतुर्दश fourteen, राक्षसाः demons, प्रेषिताः were sent.

40007134.author: Translation
40007134.content: O warrior  you had sent, out of anger, fourteen demons to put an end to Rama along with Lakshmana in order to please me.

40007135.author: पदार्थः
40007135.content: सामर्षाः those spirited ones, शूलपट्टसपाणयः with spears in hands, ते those, सर्वे all, रामेण by Rama, मर्मभेदिभिः hearts pierced, सायकैः by arrows, निहताः killed.

40007135.author: Translation
40007135.content: The demons who went with spears in their hands were killed, their hearts pierced by  Rama's arrows.

40007136.author: पदार्थः
40007136.content: क्षणेनैव in moments, भूमौ on earth, पतितान् fallen down, महाबलान् mighty ones, तान् them, रामस्य Rama's, महत् great, कर्म च action, दृष्ट्वा seeing, मम to me, महान् powerful, त्रासः fear, अभवत् befell.

40007136.author: Translation
40007136.content: Seeing the powerful demons collapse on the ground in a moment's time through Rama's action, I was frightened.

40007137.author: पदार्थः
40007137.content: निशाचर O demon , अहम् I, समुद्विग्ना scared, विषण्णा sad, च and, अस्मि am, सर्वतः all over, भयदर्शिनी  fear in sight, पुनः again, त्वाम् your, शरणं प्राप्ता sought refuge in you.

40007137.author: Translation
40007137.content: O demon  I am scared and sad. To me everything looks frightening. I, therefore, seek refuge in you.

40007138.author: पदार्थः
40007138.content: विषादनक्राध्युषिते  by crocodiles of distress, परित्रासोर्मिमालिनि filled with rows of waves of fright, विपुले  vast , शोकसागरे  in sea of sorrow, मग्नाम् drowned, माम् me, किम् why, न त्रायसे you do not save?

40007138.author: Translation
40007138.content: I am drowned in a vast sea of sorrow where crocodiles in the form of distress reside. It is full of rows of waves of fright. Why do you not save me?

40007139.author: पदार्थः
40007139.content: पिशिताशनाः  carnivorous, ये those, राक्षसाः demons, मे my, पदवीम् path, प्राप्ता came, एते च these, रामेण by Rama, भूमौ on the earth, निशितैः by sharp, शरैः arrows, निहताः were killed.

40007139.author: Translation
40007139.content: The demons who live on flesh, who came following me fell down on earth and lay dead,  shot by the sharp arrows of Rama.

40007140.author: पदार्थः
40007140.content: निशाचर O nightranger, ते yours, मयि in me, तेषु among them, रक्षस्सु च on demons, अनुक्रोशः have compassion, अस्ति यदि if you have, ते to you, रामेण equal to Rama, शक्तिः power, तेजो वा or brilliance, अस्ति यदि if you have, दण्डकारण्यनिलयम् living inDandaka forest, राक्षसकण्टकम् enemy of demons, जहि kill.

40007140.author: Translation
40007140.content: O demon  if you have compassion for me or for the demons, if you have the power and energy to face Rama, kill the enemy of the demons living in Dandaka forest.

40007141.author: पदार्थः
40007141.content: मम my, अमित्रम् enemy, रामम् that Rama, त्वम् you, अद्य now, न वधिष्यसि यदि if you do not kill, निरपत्रप O shameless one, तव your, अग्रतः presence, प्राणान् life, त्यक्ष्यामि will give up.

40007141.author: Translation
40007141.content: If now you do not kill that Rama, my enemy, O shameless one, I will give up my life in your very presence.

40007142.author: पदार्थः
40007142.content: त्वम् you, सबलश्च with your army too, संयुगे in an encounter, महात्मनः of the great man, रामस्य Rama's, प्रतिमुखे face to face, स्थातुम् to stand, न शक्तः you are not capable, अहम् I, बुद्ध्या through my intellect, अनुपश्यामि I can foresee.

40007142.author: Translation
40007142.content: Instinctively I can foresee that you and your army do not have the capability to encounter that great Rama in a fight.

40007143.author: पदार्थः
40007143.content: यः who, मानुषौ two humans, तौ रामलक्ष्मणौ those Rama and Lakshmana, हन्तुम् to kill, न शक्नोषि you are not able to, त्वम् you, शूरमानी calling yourself a hero, नशूरः त्वम् you are not a hero, मिथ्यारोपितविक्रमः your claim to be a hero is false.

40007143.author: Translation
40007143.content: You call yourself a hero, yet are not able to kill two humans like Rama and Lakshmana. Your claim to heroism is false. You are not a hero at all.

40007144.author: पदार्थः
40007144.content: कुलपांसन a disgrace to the family, निशाचर O demon , रामेण by Rama, ते your, शक्तिः power, तेजो वा or brilliance, अस्ति यदि if it is, दण्डकारण्यनिलयम् dwelling in Dandaka forest, तम् him, जहि kill.

40007144.author: Translation
40007144.content: O demon  you are a disgrace to the family. If you have power or energy, kill that Rama dwelling in Dandaka forest.

40007145.author: पदार्थः
40007145.content: निस्सत्वस्य of a man who has no strength, अल्पवीर्यस्य of less valiant one, ते your, इह here, वास: stay, कीदृशः what kind of, सहबान्धव: with your relations, त्वरितः quickly, जनस्थानात् from this Janasthana, अपयाहि go away.

40007145.author: Translation
40007145.content: You have little strength and less heroism. You with your relations should immediately leave Janasthana. What kind of position do you have here?

40007146.author: पदार्थः
40007146.content: त्वं you, रामतेजोभिभूतः let down by the brilliance of Rama, क्षिप्रं swiftly, हि indeed, विनशिष्यसि you will be surely destroyed, सः he, हि दशरथात्मजः son of Dasaratha, रामः Rama, तेजस्समायुक्तः endowed with brilliance, येन by whom, विरूपिता अस्मि I am disfigured, अस्य भ्राता च and his brother, महावीर्यः a very valiant man.

40007146.author: Translation
40007146.content: Let down by the brilliance of Rama, son of Dasaratha, you will be soon destroyed. He is mighty and his brother who has disfigured me is very valiant.

40007147.author: पदार्थः
40007147.content: त्वं you, रामतेजोभिभूतः let down by the brilliance of Rama, क्षिप्रं swiftly, हि indeed, विनशिष्यसि you will be surely destroyed, सः he, हि दशरथात्मजः son of Dasaratha, रामः Rama, तेजस्समायुक्तः endowed with brilliance, येन by whom, विरूपिता अस्मि I am disfigured, अस्य भ्राता च and his brother, महावीर्यः a very valiant man.

40007147.author: Translation
40007147.content: Let down by the brilliance of Rama, son of Dasaratha, you will be soon destroyed. He is mighty and his brother who has disfigured me is very valiant.

40007148.author: पदार्थः
40007148.content: विततोदरी  big bellied woman, राक्षसी demoness i, बहुशः in several ways, एवम् in that manner, विलप्य  weeping, भृशदुःखिता very sad, कराभ्याम् with both her hands, उदरम् belly (here, chest), हत्वा beating, रुरोद cried.

40007148.author: Translation
40007148.content: Overcome by sorrow, the bigbellied demoness cried  in several ways and being very sad started beating her chest with both hands. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे एकविंशस्सर्गः। Thus ends the twentyfirst sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
